mods.name: Applied Smelting
mods.description: Smelt items directly from an Applied Energistics 2 network using the ME Smelter and ME Smelting Terminal.

releases.notes:
# Applied Smelting v0.4.0

Three new machines and a new power option for your ME network.

## New machines
- **ME Blast Furnace** — processes Blast Furnace recipes (ores etc.) at double the ME Smelter's speed, with its own independent network queue.
- **ME Smoker** — processes Smoker recipes for fast food automation, with its own independent network queue.
- **ME Crucible** — melts ore and raw metal into molten metal, storing it directly in ME fluid storage. Automatically uses Productive Metalworks's molten metal fluids if installed, otherwise falls back to its own.

## Terminal
- The ME Smelting Terminal now has dedicated tabs for Smelting, Blasting, and Smoking, so all three machine types' queues are managed from one terminal.

## Other additions
- Sky Dust and Sky Stone Block can now be processed in the Blast Furnace, not just a regular furnace.
- A third power option: draw lava directly from your ME network's fluid storage to run any of the four machines, alongside furnace fuel and AE power.

## Fixes
- Status light no longer shows on the wrong face for machines placed facing east or west.
- Machines missing fuel/power now say so, instead of showing the more ambiguous "waiting for a recipe."

releases.notes:
- Added three higher tiers of ME Smelter — Mk1, Mk2, and Mk3 — sitting alongside the original as separate blocks with higher base speed, more upgrade slots, lower power draw, better fuel efficiency, and more network queue capacity the further you go.
- Added a crafting chain to upgrade a placed ME Smelter in place: craft a Smelter Upgrade Template, then a Mk1 Upgrade Kit, then a Mk2 Upgrade Kit, then a Mk3 Upgrade Kit, each built from the previous one. Shift-right-click a smelter with the matching kit to upgrade it.
- Upgrading a smelter keeps everything it was doing — installed cards, pinned recipe, in-progress smelting, fuel, and its place in the network queue all carry over, nothing resets.
- ME Smelters (all tiers) now glow with AE2-style cyan conduit lines and status lights, brighter and more pronounced on higher tiers.
- Tier stats (speed, power draw, fuel efficiency, upgrade slots, queue capacity) are now configurable, for modpack authors who want to rebalance them.

releases.notes:
Applied Smelting v0.2.0 lets multiple ME Smelters work together from a shared network queue, adds a redesigned terminal, and introduces new power and upgrade options.

## Changes

- Multiple ME Smelters can now work together from one shared list of recipes, so several machines can smelt different items from your ME network at the same time.
- Added a network smelting queue to the ME Smelting Terminal — queue up recipes and watch them get worked on live.
- Redesigned the terminal with a simple grid: see everything queued, what each one produces, and which ones are actively being smelted at a glance.
- Added a dedicated Fuel tab for picking your smelting fuel, right from ME storage or straight out of your own inventory — works with any pack's custom fuels, not just vanilla.
- You can now pin a specific recipe to one ME Smelter by right-clicking it while holding a smeltable item, so that machine always works that recipe instead of pulling from the shared queue.
- Smelters can now run on AE power instead of furnace fuel, your choice per machine.
- Added Energy Cards (less power use), Fuel Efficiency Cards (fuel lasts longer), Capacity Cards (bigger shared queue), and Redstone Cards (only run on a redstone signal), joining the existing Acceleration Cards.
- ME Smelters now have 8 upgrade slots instead of 4, with a cleaner status display.
- Fixed smelters occasionally hopping between queued recipes instead of sticking with one until it runs out or hits its target.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- NeoForge 26.1.2.80 or newer compatible 26.1 build
- Applied Energistics 2 26.1.10-beta or newer compatible 26.1 build
- Java 25

This is a beta prerelease. Back up important worlds before testing and please report any issues found in larger ME networks.

releases.notes:
Applied Smelting v0.1.2 improves the ME Smelting Terminal with clearer processing feedback and AE2-style network controls.

## Changes

- Centred the furnace input, flame, and fuel layout with additional vertical spacing.
- Replaced the custom flame artwork with Minecraft's standard animated furnace flame sprite.
- Fixed the furnace panel rendering order so status and progress information remain visible.
- Added current stored output reporting and configurable output targets.
- Added a dedicated AE2-style Smelting Settings screen inspired by the ME Drive priority screen.
- Replaced Pause/Run with AE2's native redstone ON/OFF toggle.
- Added priority-style target adjustment controls; a target of `0` enables unlimited smelting until input or fuel runs out.
- Preserved power and target settings when closing and reopening the interface or reloading the world.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- NeoForge 26.1.2.80 or newer compatible 26.1 build
- Applied Energistics 2 26.1.10-beta or newer compatible 26.1 build
- Java 25

This is a beta prerelease. Back up important worlds before testing and please report any issues found in larger ME networks.

releases.notes:
# Applied Smelting 0.1.1

Initial beta release for Minecraft 26.1.2.

## Added

- **ME Smelter** for processing furnace recipes directly from ME storage
- **ME Smelting Terminal** that connects to AE2 cable networks
- Selection of smeltable resources and valid furnace fuels from network storage
- Click and drag-and-drop selection controls
- Automatic extraction of inputs and insertion of finished products
- Configurable target amounts to stop processing once enough output is stored
- Network-wide pause and resume controls
- Support for multiple connected ME Smelters
- Live smelting progress bar and percentage
- Machine-status reporting, including:
  - Smelting
  - Paused
  - Network offline
  - Missing input
  - Missing fuel
  - Missing AE power
  - Storage full
  - Target reached
  - Invalid recipe
- Animated furnace flame showing remaining fuel
- Up to four AE2 Acceleration Cards:
  - 1 card: 2× speed
  - 2 cards: 4× speed
  - 3 cards: 8× speed
  - 4 cards: 16× speed
- Directional ME Smelter placement
- Original block textures designed to complement AE2

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2
- NeoForge 26.1.2.80 or newer compatible 26.1 build
- Applied Energistics 2 26.1.10-beta or newer compatible 26.1 build

## Beta Notice

Applied Smelting is under active development. Features, balance, interfaces, recipes and artwork may change before the first stable release.

Back up important worlds before testing beta releases. Bug reports and compatibility feedback are welcome.
